intent: Record the batch rules a requirements patrol changed or added.
observable_outcome: get-context batch lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An evaluation batch waits when Run refuses a trial with a refusal Run says will pass on its own, pauses with the reason recorded when the refusal awaits a credit top-up, and stops with the reason recorded on any other refusal.
A batch paused for 30 days stops with reason paused_too_long; one paused for less stays paused and can be resumed from its next unrun trial.
